set.body:
Files: a new tools/ci/collect_first_level_branch_evidence.py (or small shared collector extension), offline API fixtures/tests; docs/release-assurance.md defines the expected checks.
Steps: use tools/github/gh-repo to inspect the canonical candidate branch's protection and applicable rulesets. Record raw payloads, observation time, repository, branch, candidate SHA and hashes in the P4.4d format. Evaluate the documented required first-level checks against the effective policy; handle absent protection and 403/404 as unverified with a reason. Pending or missing checks must not be inferred from workflow YAML alone.
Acceptance: offline tests for protected branch with expected checks, missing required check, absent policy, permission failure and ruleset-provided checks. Capture the live candidate policy and validate the resulting bundle. This task is read-only with respect to GitHub settings. If the repository lacks the adopted protection, record a blocker and a concrete proposed policy for owner action; never change it as part of collection.
set.title: P4.4g: collect and verify the required branch-policy snapshot
